stories.title: Myanmar committed genocide against Rohingya minority, top UN court rules
stories.summary: The unprecedented International Court of Justice verdict concerns a 2017 military crackdown that killed thousands.
stories.detail: The International Court of Justice found that Myanmar security forces "acted with genocidal intent" against the Rohingya during military operations in the northern Rakhine state in 2017.

stories.title: Vote for next leader of Ontario Liberals to conclude on Friday
stories.summary: Ontario Liberals wrap up a long leadership race Saturday, and, they hope, an even longer stretch without a long-term leader, as the party gets set to name the person they have selected to shepherd them into the next election.

details.summary: Ontario Liberals wrap up a long leadership race Saturday, and, they hope, an even longer stretch without a long-term leader, as the party gets set to name the person they have selected to shepherd them into the next election.
The party has been in relative political wilderness since 2018, when the Liberals not only lost to Doug Ford's Progressive Conservatives, but their official party status.

stories.title: Democrats say law firm gave $11.8m in free services to Trump administration
stories.summary: Three top Democrats called Trump's dealings with law firms a case of 'official coercion' and pledged investigations.
stories.detail: U.S. congressional Democrats probing law firms that made deals with President Donald Trump's ‌administration said on Thursday that Kirkland & Ellis has provided at least $11.8 million US in free legal services to federal agencies.

stories.title: Trump's midterm defeat hasn't moved Canada-U.S. trade talks, sources say
stories.summary: Sources say Canada-U.S. trade talks have not meaningfully changed since the U.S. midterm vote.
stories.detail: According to sources present at a meeting with Prime Minister Mark Carney and Donald Trump in China, the biggest trade issue is the 25 per cent U.S. tariff on Canadian automobiles.

stories.title: Senate Republicans in US reject measure to limit Trump’s war powers in Iran
stories.summary: The resolution was defeated 51-48. Three Republicans broke rank, voting for the measure.
